The hook is `useFeatureFlag` in `esm-react-utils`. It reads a flag's `enabled` value from a global store in `esm-feature-flags`, which is persisted in `localStorage`.

**How it works**

1. A component calls `useFeatureFlag("flag-name")`. The hook subscribes to `featureFlagsStore` through `useStore` and returns `flags[flagName]?.enabled ?? false`, so an unregistered or off flag yields `false` ([useFeatureFlag.ts:18-23](openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useFeatureFlag.ts)).
2. `featureFlagsStore` is a global store created in `feature-flags.ts`. On load it is seeded from `localStorage` keys `openmrs:feature-flag:<name>` and `openmrs:feature-flag-meta:<name>`. Every store change writes them back ([feature-flags.ts:14-42](openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts)).
3. Flags are declared with `registerFeatureFlag(flagName, label, description)`. Re-registering keeps the existing enabled state ([feature-flags.ts:54-65](openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts)). `setFeatureFlag` (used by Implementer Tools) flips the value ([feature-flags.ts:112-119](openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts)).
4. Non-React code uses `getFeatureFlag` (synchronous read, [feature-flags.ts:91-93](openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts)) or `subscribeToFeatureFlag` ([feature-flags.ts:105-109](openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts)). Both docs say to prefer `useFeatureFlag` in React.

**Documentation**

The guide is `feature-flags.mdx` in the O3 docs. It covers declaring flags in `routes.json` (`featureFlags`), the Implementer Tools toggle, app-shell configuration (`Enabled feature flags`), and a `useFeatureFlag("laser-eyes")` example. It also notes that the hook returns `false` for absent flags ([feature-flags.mdx:5-16](openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/feature-flags.mdx), [62-81](openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/feature-flags.mdx)).

I did not read the app-shell code that applies the `Enabled feature flags` config, and I did not search the patient chart for call sites, so those are not covered here.
